conclusion: Fused up-projection geometry failed strict numerical equivalence. Dense8-onlyFP8 improved a bounded same-placement timing sample but failed held-out screening. Forward-rounded VJP and exact valid-token padding skipping also failed first comparable probes. No combination is justified.
next_exploratory_hypothesis: Bounded compact coordinate-difference interaction, zero initialized after independent GS32 features. Distinguishes nearby coordinates across sign quadrants rather than multiplying separate coordinate transforms; independent pathways remain.
motivation_limitations: Earlier additive interactions produced small activation effects, but that does not prove insufficient capacity. A difference-dependent basis changes interaction geometry and can cost runtime. No projected convergence gain is claimed.
